column1: # Flaky-test quarantine for the fast ship gate (GATE_SPEED.md X5). Tab-separated: pytest node id, owner, expires YYYY-MM-DD, reason.
# A row deselects that test in the fast ship gate only (CI still runs it). Expired rows deselect nothing and fail step 3qn.
# Rows are read from origin/fast-track, so a ship cannot quarantine its own failing test. Live-path ids (execution/, runtime/, MyTradingSys/tests/) are refused. Expiry may be at most 14 days ahead.
